title: Research: sharp 192-array information bound for the P104 literal repair
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds `research/p104-literal-repair-rank/`. The full error from applying the old correction to PR #3954's literal encoded P104 banks has rank **192d**, where one array has complex dimension d. Its data kernel has dimension **16d**. The 72 arbitrary dirty helpers remain unchanged, giving complete kernel dimension 88d. The predecessors established the first-bank rank 96d and the block commutator; this contribution quantifies the complete two-bank boundary.

For `J=I-H`, `H^2=H`, invertible T and `HT=TH`, the new scoped lemma is

`rank(PA-AP)=2 rank(H)+rank(J(D-I)J)`.

The actual pivot block is `D_JJ=I_8`, giving 192d. Neither `DT=TD` nor commutation between address blocks is assumed. The unique postprocessor is `R=APA^-1P^-1`. If its entire increment factors through k array-sized linear summaries, `R(s)=s+VUs`, then **k>=192**. An explicit algebraic factorization attains 192 using the summaries `r_N` and `w_N-B^t r_J`.

This changes the consumer from a uniform scalar correction to arbitrary input-independent linear summaries. It is a **scoped proof and source-bound finite audit**.

**What the 192 means.** It is an information bound under the stated contract: the dimension of linear information an exact additive repair of this form must receive, even when forming and moving the summaries is free. It is not a native-call tariff, not a lower bound on simultaneous scratch storage, and not a physical implementation or supplier. It gives no new κ. Existing-helper restoration is established for the declared identity extension; new scratch formation and restoration are not supplied. The selected record (#5413, κ = 0.003027288235) is unchanged.

The eight-file package's PROOF.md contains the argument and complete obligation ledger; RESULT.json contains the deterministic 512-pattern receipt. No shared code or frozen predecessor is changed.

No reroll. This closes one bounded information obligation, not the complete adjacent-call handoff.
- **Base:** head `02d6f8da9e6717fe1115413b8684366a0beef140` on base main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Canonical main was fetched again at 2026-10-25T05:44:01Z and checked again at 06:03Z, unchanged; relevant guidance, sources and the selected record are unchanged.

Their live proof bytes on main match those heads. SOURCES.json pins all four actual inputs to the canonical base by Git blob and SHA256. No pending executable is imported.
- **Claim:** [discussion #1166 comment 19173713](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19173713), following the [literal-slot finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19057044) and the original [adjacent-pair handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19034066).
- **Method/domain:** dimension-free kernel proof; all 512 physical phase patterns and all 280 input columns; exact sparse Gaussian composition; separate rational elimination over all 2,048 small cases; a noncommuting address-block fixture and controls. No parameter search.
- **Milestone/budget:** one scoped proof/audit within a 60-minute budget. Free summaries are granted only for the information lower bound. Physical acquisition, new scratch restoration, conversions, owners, movement, precision and the complete recursive bill remain unknown. No changed invoice is asserted, so there is no new signed-invoice pair to compare.
- **Stop:** narrow after this interface result. The inherited 44,096-excess scaffold remains rejected; do not convert 192 information dimensions into 192 paid native ranks or expand the construction on this evidence.

This account's earlier P104 acquisition, matching, native-transport and precision PRs are not repeated.

Offline task and literal/commutator/repair-rank searches covered 7,404 complete local HEAD records. Final cache: 371 open PRs including drafts at 05:43:08Z and 4,779 Discussion records at 05:33:05Z on 25 October, both with complete pagination. The board and claim scopes were reread. Coverage does not include every arbitrary diff or unpublished result and is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

Environment: Linux, CPython 3.12.3, standard library. All checks pass at head `02d6f8da9e6717fe1115413b8684366a0beef140`.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-literal-repair-rank --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-literal-repair-rank
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-literal-repair-rank --check-source-history
```

The registered replay runs the main checker normally and under `-O`, followed by the independent dense implementation. It passes in about two minutes (121.77 seconds measured); a direct optimized main replay takes about 60 seconds and 21 MiB. The source-history and committed-byte check covers 12 package/input files. The official committed export and bundle integrity check passed; both direct scripts passed in a read-only Git-free export.

Evidence:

- 143,360 complete literal columns and 143,360 postprocessor columns, covering 512 patterns times 208 data plus 72 dirty inputs; every minor, kernel and endpoint checked exactly.
- 2,048 separate dense rational cases, a noncommuting address-block repair, a pivot change raising rank 8 to 9, and two dropped-hypothesis controls.
- Seven semantic rejection groups: omitted second-bank response, incomplete repair, wrong sign, wrong slot convention, leaked/erased helper dirt, and uncancelled summary dirt. All 192 summary-dirt basis directions produce nonzero output.
- Private export controls reject altered source bytes and replacing a determinant integer 1 by Boolean true in the receipt. All acceptance checks remain active under optimized Python.

Expected main marker:

```text
PASS_P104_LITERAL_REPAIR_RANK rank=192 data_kernel=16 dirty_helpers=72 characters=512 columns=143360 summary_arrays=192 controls=7 no_new_kappa
```

then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.

Not run or claimed: original full native-word replay, actual physical producer/consumer, new dirty-scratch protocol, compiler/ordinary/outer admission, complete supplier moment, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, hosted CI, independent human review or formal-kernel proof. The all-dimensional claim rests on the written proof, with finite corroboration.

More rank calculations or phase patterns do not resolve them.
